data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding (insurance liabilities) reduced from $834.9m at 1 Jan 2022 to $755.1m at 31 Dec 2022, indicating an overall release in reserves during the year. The report does not provide an explicit GROSS prioryear development (PYD) figure separate from current year movements in the technical provision reconciliation; a granular PYD number (gross) was not identified in the notes or managing agent text. The claims development table is presented (gross and net) but alignment in the published table prevents a straightforward extraction of a single gross PYD figure using the diagonal method without ambiguity. Reserve judgments are described as driven by standard actuarial projection techniques and past claims development.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year development (PYD) figure was found in the notes. The technical reserves reconciliation shows a gross movement in 'Claims outstanding' for the year (gross movement = -71,433 $'000) but that line includes current year activity and therefore was not used per the rules. A gross claims development triangle is present (pages 25) but the tabular formatting in the PDF makes diagonal extraction ambiguous; consequently a definitive gross PYD amount could not be computed with high confidence. Opening reserves were taken from the Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2022 = $834,875k). All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and in millions (values converted from $'000).
